title: On Frying the fish in one pan
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：fry　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fry 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the athlete ① fried the fish in one pan in public, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the athlete ② fries the fish in one pan in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ fry the fish in one pan at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ fried the fish in one pan before — a line in the programme for September 1959 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Frying the fish in one pan in public, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ fry two eggs for the traveller in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Fry two eggs for the traveller at once and never mention it again.

By 1972 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new trainer from the next stadium ⑧ fries two eggs for the traveller in public every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the track, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ fried the fish in one pan again when nobody else would.

⑩ To fry the fish in one pan, my mother said in 1977, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the stadium remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the stadium forgets, somebody fries the fish in one pan in silence again and somebody must fry the fish in one pan in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 油煎（一般过去式 fried the fish in one pan：1965 年运动员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 油煎（一般现在 fries the fish in one pan：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 油煎（不定式 to fry the fish in one pan：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 油煎（过去完成时 had fried the fish in one pan：1959 年九月的秩序册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 油煎（动名词 frying the fish in one pan 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 煎（fry two eggs for the traveller：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去煎给那位旅客煎了两个蛋）
G. v. 煎（fry two eggs for the traveller：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 油煎（后段两处：新来的陪练照例 fries two eggs for the traveller，而母亲又一次 fried the fish in one pan）

fry 意为“油煎”，结尾那句是母亲 1977 年的话：要油煎在一只锅里把鱼煎了，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和体育场记住的那一件。

母亲后来说，难就难在肯油煎在一只锅里把鱼煎了这件事本身。（to fry the fish in one pan）
早在 1959 年就有人油煎在一只锅里把鱼煎了，九月那天秩序册上的一行字就是证据。（had fried the fish in one pan）
运动员说过，当着众人面油煎在一只锅里把鱼煎了这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（frying the fish in one pan 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻煎给那位旅客煎了两个蛋，以后再也不要提起。（fry two eggs for the traveller，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fry 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the athlete fried the fish in one pan in public, and nobody in the stadium forgot it.
Even now the athlete fries the fish in one pan in silence whenever the stadium asks.
Frying the fish in one pan in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever fry two eggs for the traveller in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainer from the next stadium fries two eggs for the traveller in public every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother fried the fish in one pan again, and the stadium remembered that half.
